# Internet Archive

> > A non-profit digital library offering free access to millions of books, movies, software, music, websites, and historical collections.

The Internet Archive provides permanent access to historical collections through its Wayback Machine and hosts digitized cultural artifacts including manuscripts like the Peresopnytsia Gospel. Users can download content in multiple formats (PDF, ePUB, ZIP) using tools like wget and the Internet Archive Command-line Tool.

## Download Guides

- [Downloading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-a-basic-guide/): Comprehensive guide to downloading content from Internet Archive using wget, command-line tools, and bulk download options

## Historical Collections

- [Peresopnytsia Gospel 1556-1561: Research & Transliterated Text](https://archive.org/details/PY1561): Digitized 16th-century Ukrainian manuscript with research, transliterated text, and concordance by Chepiga I.P. and other scholars
